Hi Alex — thanks for the context and the draft PO.

Two quick things on our side:
- We can approve a staged sandbox allowance in two ways (policy-dependent):
  1) A temporary token grant (non-billable) for up to 7 days to preserve demos; or
  2) A time-limited sandbox extension tied to the PO number and a hard cutoff date.

To move this forward I need:
1) Confirmed PO number (if available) or the expected clearance date from procurement.
2) The security contact at Medicorps who can confirm vendor onboarding status (we sometimes coordinate directly with the procurement/security reviewer).

If you can share the PO number and expected clearance timeframe I will route for manager signoff (Markus) and flag this to Accounting so the temporary credit is tracked against DEAL-9832.

If you prefer, I can provision a small token block now (7 days) as a conservative option while Markus reviews. Which would you prefer?

— Olga
